title: Enterprise Document Management System (DMS)
shortDescription: A robust document management system built with automated AI metadata tagging, full-text search, and granular security controls.
fullDescription: Designed and shipped an end-to-end Enterprise DMS. Features include high-throughput document ingestion, automated OCR, LLM-powered categorization, role-based access control (RBAC), and immutable audit logs.

title: Artavix PM: Enterprise Project & AI Resource Planning
shortDescription: Full-stack enterprise project management system featuring Groq AI project telemetry, WBS control, SignalR chat, and resource capacity planning.
fullDescription: A comprehensive project tracking software enabling teams to manage WBS hierarchies, interactive Gantt timelines, capacity overflow alerts, and instant Groq LPU AI health score analytics.

title: Executive Business Analytics Dashboard
shortDescription: Real-time executive dashboard aggregating multi-channel business metrics, predictive revenue forecasting, and dynamic data visualization.
fullDescription: Built a high-performance analytics platform that ingests live metrics from sales, operations, and user retention. Includes natural language querying for custom chart generation.

title: Smart Sports Club Management Platform
shortDescription: Complete operational software for sports facilities, handling automated member check-ins, subscription billing, and trainer scheduling.
fullDescription: All-in-one management tool for fitness centers. Includes barcode/QR member access, automated recurring payment reminders, coach availability tracking, and executive financial reporting.

title: Custom Internal Automation Suite
shortDescription: Rapidly developed internal tools for operational workflow automation, reducing manual data entry by 80%.
fullDescription: Tailored business process automation applications built for speed and integration, replacing complex spreadsheets with unified, secure internal micro-web apps.
